title: The Dam That Failed Hours After Being Declared Safe

lines: Just before midnight, a California dam burst.
A wall of water swept down the valley toward the sea, killing hundreds.
That same morning, it had been inspected and called safe.
The engineers had seen new leaks.
They looked like the usual seepage.
But the rock beneath one side was weak and softening.
When it gave way, the dam broke apart.
California then created state oversight for dam safety.
